title: Maximum Profit Job Scheduling
prompt:
Implement `job_scheduling(start_times, end_times, profits) -> int`. The three equally sized arrays describe jobs: job `i` starts at `start_times[i]`, ends at `end_times[i]`, and earns `profits[i]`. Choose a subset with maximum total profit such that selected jobs do not overlap.

A job ending at time `t` is compatible with another job starting at time `t`. Return `0` for no jobs. Do not assume time values are small or consecutive.

example.reasoning: Taking the jobs from 1 to 3 and from 3 to 6 yields the best compatible total.
